messages:
Renee: Heads-up: impromptu couch speedrun night tomorrow? Thinking 2-player co-op speedrun challenges + a casual free-for-all Smash warmup. Need a few things: extra controllers, one short HDMI cable, and a power strip.
Ollie: I can bring two wired Xbox pads and a 1.2m HDMI. Also I have a little travel surge strip.
Sam: I'll bring my Switch dock and one Pro Controller. Also down to try a 2v2 timed run—loser buys coffee. :coffee: 
Priya: If we want low lag for Steam runs, use Steam Link in "Remote Play Together" mode and prefer wired on the host. Quick tip: on Windows host, enable "In-Home Streaming"): Settings > Remote Play > Enable.
Renee: Love it. Also curious if anyone wants to do a short speedrun race on Celeste (any%) or try out a local co-op indie I found.
Ollie: Celeste any% sounds spicy. I'm rusty but I'll enter. Prize: office sticker and bragging rights.
Sam: I'll do the local indie warm-up. What time are we meeting?
Renee: Plan: set up 18:40, warm-up at 19:00, Celeste race 19:30. Space: back lounge by kitchen. patch-bot: Room reservation confirmed: Back Lounge 18:30-22:00 by Renee.
Priya: Also FYI if you're plugging into the office projector, bring an adapter if your laptop is USB-C only. I have a spare USB-C->HDMI adapter I can bring.
Ollie: Short ethernet cable request: anyone have a 0.5-1m spare? My laptop's port is tight to the couch.
Sam: I have a 0.5m patch. Bringing it.
Renee: Controller pool so far: Ollie x2, Sam x1, Priya x1 (maybe). If you need a controller, DM me and I'll tag you in the shared list.
Priya: Also if anyone wants to stream clips, bring a capture dongle. Marcus lent me his last time but he's out.
Renee: Cool. Final: arrive ~18:40 to help with set-up. See you all tomorrow — may the fastest clip win :trophy:
